answer: Dormant-account tax: any identity that submits no verified work for 8 consecutive epochs loses 2% of its balance each epoch, paid to active graders. Parking 1,000 fakes with 100 POA each in a vault costs 2,000 POA per epoch, so upkeep grows linearly with headcount. Anyone can recompute decay from public chain history. A long voyage of honest work pays the tax once, in nectar-sized amounts.
